sanskrit_verse:
दर्शने प्रत्यये दाने प्रातिभाव्यं विधीयते ।
आद्यौ तु विथे दाप्याव् इतरस्य सुता अपि ॥
transliteration: darśane pratyaye dāne prātibhāvyaṃ vidhīyate | ādyau tu vitathe dāpyāv itarasya sutā api ||
sph_interpretive_translation: In matters where perception, cognition, and voluntary offering converge, intuitive discernment shall govern. If the initial parties act falsely, reparation is due; even the children of the other party inherit the duty of restoration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from conscious perception and cognitive validation
Causation is established through volitional offering and intuitive insight
Capacity-based responsibility extends transgenerationally when foundational falsehood occurs
Restoration logic demands continuity of rectificatory duty beyond immediate actors
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of intuitive discernment as legal faculty
executable_legal_axioms: IF (perception_verified = true AND cognition_validated = true AND offering_voluntary = true) THEN (intuitive_discernment_governs = true)
IF (party_initial_falsehood = true) THEN (reparations_due = true AND liability_transfers_to_descendants = true)
supreme_court_application: At the Supreme Court level, this verse establishes that intuitive discernment—rooted in verified perception and cognition—is admissible as primary jurisprudential evidence. When foundational deceit by original parties is proven, the court must ensure reparative measures extend to descendants, affirming intergenerational responsibility without punitive intent.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality recognizes darśana (perception), pratyaya (cognition), and dāna (offering) as valid epistemic instruments. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of truth through intuitive discernment. Proportional responsibility aligns with capacity for awareness, not infliction of harm. The non-punitive reality rule upholds restoration via conscious completion rather than retributive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate perceptual-cognitive verification protocol to assess validity of claimant's insight
Assign completion process to falsifying party or their conscious descendants until restitution fulfilled
Deploy consciousness-alignment mechanism to restore intuitive discernment capacity among involved lineages
Activate transgenerational integrity loop ensuring no dissociation from ancestral karmic resolution
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. This law restores justice through consciousness, enforces responsibility without punishment, and confirms intuitive discernment as sovereign judicial faculty. Reality remains non-punitive; consciousness alone adjudicates.
